moments.title: The Hundred Cricket: Week of Action
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues its group stage this week, with exciting 100-ball matches taking place across the UK, building towards Finals Day on August 16th.

angles.name: Today's Game
angles.copy: It's match day in The Hundred! SunRisers Leeds take on London Spirit at Headingley today. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Tomorrow's Clash
angles.copy: Get ready for more 100-ball action tomorrow as Manchester Super Giants face Welsh Fire at Emirates Old Trafford. Don't miss it!

angles.name: Mid-Week Highlights
angles.copy: The Hundred is bringing the heat this week! Fast-paced cricket and big hits – who's been your standout player so far?

angles.name: Trent Bridge Action
angles.copy: Monday, August 10th sees Trent Rockets host Southern Brave at Trent Bridge. Grab your tickets or tune in for the excitement!

moments.title: FA Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the FA Community Shield, sees Premier League champions Arsenal take on FA Cup winners Manchester City on August 16th at Principality Stadium in Cardiff.

angles.name: Football's Back!
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The FA Community Shield kicks off the new football season on August 16th. Who's ready for some action?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff is set to host Arsenal v Manchester City for the Community Shield! Big game coming to Wales.

angles.name: Arsenal vs Man City
angles.copy: A clash of titans! Arsenal take on Manchester City for the Community Shield. Who will claim the first trophy of the season?

angles.name: Season Predictions
angles.copy: Community Shield predictions? Will Arsenal start strong or will Man City get an early edge? Tell us your thoughts!

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Geri Halliwell!
moments.blurb: Pop icon Geri Halliwell, famously known as Ginger Spice from the Spice Girls, celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6th.

angles.name: Ginger Spice Turns 54
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Ginger Spice, Geri Halliwell! What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

angles.name: Girl Power Forever
angles.copy: Celebrating Geri Halliwell's birthday on Thursday! She brought us 'Girl Power' and so many anthems. What's your top Spice Girls track?

angles.name: Solo Geri
angles.copy: Beyond the Spice Girls, Geri Halliwell gave us some fantastic solo hits like 'Mi Chico Latino' and 'It's Raining Men'. Which is your favourite?

angles.name: Iconic Style
angles.copy: From the Union Jack dress to her bold looks, Geri Halliwell has always been a style icon. Happy Birthday to a true original!

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Mark Knopfler!
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist and Dire Straits frontman Mark Knopfler turns 77 on August 12th, celebrating a prolific career spanning decades of iconic rock music.

angles.name: Guitar Maestro
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 77th Birthday to the incredible Mark Knopfler on August 12th! His guitar work is simply unparalleled.

angles.name: Dire Straits Icon
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to 'Money for Nothing', Mark Knopfler defined an era with Dire Straits. What's your favourite track?

angles.name: Soundtrack Genius
angles.copy: Did you know Mark Knopfler composed iconic film scores like 'Local Hero' and 'The Princess Bride'? Celebrating his 77th birthday on Wednesday!

angles.name: Timeless Rocker
angles.copy: Mark Knopfler's music continues to inspire generations. Join us in celebrating his 77th birthday this week!
